title: A failed import marks its operation failed and spaces recovery instructions in both modes
steps: Render the real import wizard with production CSS in Chromium. Complete its form, then answer the status door with php_too_old on PHP 7.3.33. Inspect light/dark at 390/1440px.
expect: The import segment is failed and aria-current=step, All steps completed is absent and provisioning never starts.
Recovery retry has bottom padding and its heading is inline-flex in every viewport/mode.
fence: ImportWizard and AddSiteWizard progress state, recovery CSS

tests: a failed import marks its operation failed without claiming all steps completed
